pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Start free. Upgrade when you want detailed AI explanations and larger allowances. Cancel at any time.
pricing.notes: Sales tax or VAT is added at checkout where it applies. Payments are handled by Paddle, our reseller. Buyers in mainland China pay in RMB and can use Alipay.
pricing.cardPending: Card, PayPal and Apple Pay payments are in development. For now we accept Alipay and WeChat Pay only.
pricing.metaDescription: Readfox plans: start free with 1,000 AI word lookups a month. Plus, Pro and Max give more lookups, detailed AI explanations and a bigger library. Pay by card, PayPal or Alipay.
